title: Issues
description: Known bugs, missing capabilities, design debt, and open work items. Tracked with title/body (GitHub issue pattern), code location, package scope, priority, and resolution lifecycle.

body.description: Full detail and context for downstream composition

location.description: File path + line number, e.g. packages/pi-workflows/src/dag.ts:219

package.description: Which monorepo package this issue touches (e.g. pi-workflows, pi-project, pi-behavior-monitors)

axis.description: Which axis of open work this item belongs to. Optional in the schema; required by the CI gate for status: open.

resolved_by.description: Commit message or reference if resolved

requirement.description: Which operator requirement (R1-R12, .project/requirements.json) this item serves. OPTIONAL by decision: several items are pure hygiene and serving no requirement is a real answer. The CI gate requires a cited id to EXIST; it never requires an item to cite one.
